SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Special C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 1469
Date August 15, 1930.
Date 16. 8. 30

Subject (in full) Curtis.

Made by ______ and ______ Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.

Sir,

From further enquiries made it has been learned that
Curtis who resides at No. 22 Feng Loh Lee is the person
who approached Mr. Needham regarding the garbage contract.

* Ref. to
J.D. 7475.
Curtis* is very friendly with the Compradore of Algar
& Co., No. 5 Hongkong Road, and it is possible that he
induced Curtis to approach Mr. Needham.

This compradore has some very good business connections
and Curtis is at times employed by him to conduct
negotiations regarding land deals, etc.

Curtis is about 37 years of age, medium height and
build, speaks Japanese and Chinese fluently.

JB.

W Duncan
D. S. I.

D. C.
(C. & S. Branches)

E.C.P.

Information.

(印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 17 MAY 1957 CRIME BRANCH)

15 AUG. 1930
D. C. (C. & S. B.)

4/10/12

上海公共租界工部局警务处

主题（全称）柯蒂斯（Curtis）。

由 ______ 和 ______ 制作，由副督察邓肯（D.S.I. Duncan）转呈。

先生，

经进一步查询获悉，
居住于丰乐里22号的柯蒂斯（Curtis），即是就垃圾清运合同一事接触尼达姆先生（Mr. Needham）之人。

* 参见
J.D. 7475。
柯蒂斯* 与香港路5号阿尔加公司（Algar & Co.）的买办关系甚密，有可能是该买办唆使柯蒂斯去接触尼达姆先生。

这位买办拥有极佳的商业人脉，柯蒂斯时常受其雇佣，代为进行土地交易等方面的谈判。

柯蒂斯年约37岁，中等身材，能流利使用日语和汉语。

JB.

W 邓肯
副督察（D. S. I.）

副 commissioner
（刑事与特别科）

E.C.P.

情报。

No. S. B. D. 1469
Date July 31 1930.
70. 8. 30.）

Subject (in full) Curtis.

Made by _______ and _______ Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.

Sir,
Enquiries show that Curtis is residing at No. 22
Fong Loh Lee (豐樂里) off North Szechuen Road extension.
He claims to be a real estate agent but is not known to
do much business, and as far as can be learned he is
not connected with the Chinese Authorities.
A person by the name of Curtis some little time ago
attended a dinner given by the Mayor of the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai. He was not officially invited
but was taken in by a Chinese friend and introduced.
Curtis is not regarded as a friend of the Mayor.

Wkeman,
D. S. I.

D. C.
(C. & S. Branches)

（批：JMG
31.7.30.
sec (cross)
Curtis approached Mr Neatham
some weeks ago offering to introduce him to
the mayor re garbage contract. Curtis has
a Japanese friend who is a sort of adviser to
the mayor, he & Curtis having once saved
his (the mayor's) life when he was in danger
(presumably from his own countrymen). Curtis
is or was interested in the garbage contract
himself. The interview did not take place

主题（全称）柯蒂斯（Curtis）。

由 _______ 和 _______ 制作，由副督察邓肯（D.S.I. Duncan）转呈。

先生，
经查，柯蒂斯居住于北四川路延伸段附近的丰乐里（Fong Loh Lee）22号。
他自称是房地产经纪人，但据知业务不多，且据目前了解，他与中国当局并无关联。
不久前，一名名为柯蒂斯的人出席了大上海市政府市长举办的晚宴。他并未受到正式邀请，而是由一位中国朋友带入并引见。柯蒂斯并不被视为市长的朋友。

威克曼（Wkeman），
副督察（D. S. I.）

副 commissioner
（刑事与特别科）

（批注：JMG
1930年7月31日。
秘书（划叉）
柯蒂斯数周前接触尼萨姆先生（Mr Neatham），提出将其引荐给市长，以洽谈垃圾清运合同。柯蒂斯有一位日本朋友，此人是市长的某种顾问，他和柯蒂斯曾在市长身处险境时（推测是遭其本国人迫害）救过市长的命。柯蒂斯本人对垃圾清运合同感兴趣或曾感兴趣。此次会面并未发生
1930 Rugh）

（左侧边注：抄送。（特别科）
JGM
8月1日。）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

File No.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE Headquarters C. & S. B. REGISTRATION, No. S. B. D 1469 Date July 22, 1930）

Subject (in full) Curtis

Made by J. A. Cook, C. A. Forwarded by （签名） C. S. I.

The subject of this report Curtis- a halfcaste- is
a brother of Mrs. Louis Ladow, widow of the late Louis Ladow,
former owner of the Ladow Cafe, Ningpo Road.

He is the son of a former British subject named Curtis,
and his mother was a Japanese woman.

His late father, Curtis, senior, was proprietor of a
public bar in Canton Road in 1902-3.

This young Curtis speaks Japanese and Chinese fluently,
as well as English. He was formerly employed by the late
Louis Ladow at the Old Carlton Cafe, Ningpo Road, as
supervisor of the Chinese staff, and he has been employed
in various other cafes. He is reported to be living in
Wonglo Road at present. His sister, Mrs. Louis Ladow,
is reputed to be a travelling prostitute who makes frequent
trips to Manila, Philipine Islands, and the U.S.A, in the
President Line Steamers, and plies her trade on the way.

She is suspected also of being engaged in Narcotic
smuggling.

（签名） John A. Cook
C. A.

D. C.
Cr. & Sp' Branches S2 22:7:'30.

（批：DA Please endeavour to find out what influence Curtis has in Chinese official circles and if he is employed in any branch of the Chinese service. Mr T. J. Blake of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai will be able to give information about Curtis having once attended a dinner party given by Mayor Chan Sun. JG）

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处总部 刑事与特别科登记处，编号 S. B. D 1469 日期 1930年7月22日）

主题（全称）柯蒂斯（Curtis）

由 J. A. Cook，警佐（C. A.）制作，由 （签名） 首席督察（C. S. I.）转呈。

本报告对象柯蒂斯——一名混血儿——是路易斯·拉多（Louis Ladow）遗孀、已故路易斯·拉多夫人的兄弟。已故路易斯·拉多是宁波路拉多咖啡馆（Ladow Cafe）的前所有者。

他是前英国籍民柯蒂斯（Curtis）之子，其母为日本女子。

其已故父亲老柯蒂斯（Curtis, senior）在1902-3年间是广东路一家公共酒吧的业主。

这位年轻的柯蒂斯能流利使用日语、汉语以及英语。他此前受雇于已故的路易斯·拉多，在宁波路的旧卡尔顿咖啡馆（Old Carlton Cafe）担任华人员工主管，并曾在其他多家咖啡馆任职。据报他目前居住在旺劳路（Wonglo Road）。他的姐姐，即路易斯·拉多夫人，据称是一名流动妓女，经常乘坐总统轮船公司（President Line）的蒸汽船往返于菲律宾群岛的马尼拉和美国，并在途中从事卖淫活动。

她也被怀疑参与毒品走私。

（签名）约翰·A·库克（John A. Cook）
警佐（C. A.）

副 commissioner
刑事与特别科 S2 1930年7月22日。

（批注：DA 请设法查明柯蒂斯在中国官场有何影响力，以及他是否受雇于中国政府的任何部门。大上海市政府的 T. J. Blake 先生能够提供有关柯蒂斯曾出席陈群（Chan Sun）市长举办的晚宴的信息。JG）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 1469
June 24, 1930.
Date 16. 8. 30.

With reference to attached, a person by the name
of Curtis some little time ago attended a dinner given
by the Mayor of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai.
Curtis was not officially invited but was taken in
by a Chinese friend and introduced. He is not
regarded as a friend of the Mayor.

There is a possibility that this person may
have been W.V. Curtis, British, who resided in the
Hotel de France, French Concession in 1927. Curtis
claimed to be a financial agent of the Cantonese
Government.

He left for Hankow on January 20, 1927 and
on his return here on February 23rd of that year
stated that he had had interviews with Eugene
Chen and other prominent officials. Curtis left
soon afterwards and was believed to have gone to
Canton.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别科登记处
编号 S. B. D. 1469
1930年6月24日。
日期 1930年8月16日。

关于附件所述，不久前，一名名为柯蒂斯的人出席了大上海市政府市长举办的晚宴。柯蒂斯并未受到正式邀请，而是由一位中国朋友带入并引见。他并不被视为市长的朋友。

此人有可能是 W.V. 柯蒂斯，英籍，1927年居住于法租界的法国总会酒店（Hotel de France）。柯蒂斯自称是广东省政府的财务代理。

他于1927年1月20日前往汉口，并于同年2月23日返回此处时声称，他曾与陈友仁（Eugene Chen）及其他显要官员进行过会谈。柯蒂斯随后不久便离开，据信去了广州。
